roles.duty: Adopt the plan, approve the annual budget against the MSIP
Run the year one actions, enforce the bylaws, publish the scorecard
Align ward budgets, keep the ward registers, run the ward drills
Manage the GIS, the permit process and the plan review
Run the concessions, the royalties and the product standards
Run the revenue reform and the pooling of ward allocations
Run the risk registers, the evacuation centres and the drills
Fund the lines the MSIP assigns, against the scorecard evidence
